rules: SHOOT timing samples the latest target relative position and movement; historical straight-to-player cases retain START_SHOOT caching.
Around-player target consumes two initial square draws, even when overwritten by a movement-cone sample. Moving cone consumes signed angle then distance, followed by shoot cooldown randomization.

Adds one radius behind the target along actor-to-target direction. Moving cone spans180degrees and distance radius/4..radius. Stationary target uses the square. Coincident selected points retain zero normalized direction.
Source default radius truncates min(600,max_range/5) in pixel units before point scaling. Normal max_range600 produces120px radius.

X axis overrides Y; enabled axis uses strict comparison and bypasses radial min/max. Radial Utils.is_between receives integer pixel distance: truncate distance before inclusive comparison. Integer bounds recover correctly after floating stud conversion.
World preserves two-dimensional rush direction through motion and actor transfer; source normal .75s duration,45stud/s additive bonus and .8/1.5s windup are retained.

Movement.getDirection is separate from stat-scaled getInput, so a zero-speed player can still supply a direction for charge targeting. EnemySim passes separate raw direction arrays; existing anticipation consumes scaled inputs.
